blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial will be put on hold starting Wednesday, Oct. 14, to give the prosecution time to file its formal offer of evidence, Senate Impeachment Clerk of Court Atty. Renato Bantug said on Monday. In a text message to the Inquirer, Bantug confirmed the suspension. “No trial [on Wednesday],” he wrote. On Monday, the prosecution’s last witness for impeachment Article II, which concerns Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth, was excused.
